app_fee.value: USD 155 for applicants who are not U.S. citizens or permanent residents (USD 135 U.S./PR)
app_fee.quote: Application Fees | $135.00: U.S. citizens and Permanent Residents | $155.00: All other applicants

fee_waiver.value: Need-based waivers are for U.S. citizens/PRs and others who meet criteria; a non-citizen must be receiving need-based aid from the state of California. Event-based waivers exist for in-person attendees at designated recruitment events (no citizenship rule stated).
fee_waiver.quote: Waivers of UCLA’s application fee are available for U.S. citizens, Permanent Residents and others who demonstrate financial need by meeting the following criteria: | if not a U.S. citizen or Permanent Resident, this financial aid must come from the state of California | Event-based waivers may waive the 2026-2027 application fee for PhD and state-supported doctoral programs. | Only attendees at in-person events are eligible to receive this fee waiver.

gre_general.value: General GRE accepted but not required
gre_general.quote: GRE General exam will be accepted but is not required

gre_physics.quote: GRE: Subject in Physics is strongly recommended.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 87 (before Jan 21, 2026) or 4.5 (new scale); IELTS Academic 7.0; scores under 100 / 5 / IELTS 7.5 trigger the ESLPE on arrival
toefl_min.quote: Minimum overall score on TOEFL iBT: 87 (for exams taken before January 21, 2026) or 4.5 (for exams taken on or after January 21, 2026). | Minimum overall band score on IELTS Academic: 7.0.

english_waiver.value: Exempt only with a bachelor’s from the U.S. or a country where English is the SOLE language of instruction according to the World Higher Education Database (WHED); the UCLA page lists no countries, so Indian applicants must check WHED
english_waiver.quote: Prior education – A bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited university located in the United States or in another country where English is the sole language of instruction according to the World Higher Education Database (WHED).

supervisor.value: No pre-application supervisor requirement mentioned; statement of purpose may name potential faculty mentors

funding.value: Not stated on the page checked

entry_route.value: Not stated on the page checked (program admits only Ph.D. applicants; master’s available on the doctoral track)
